# Add-ZbxTag

## SYNOPSIS

Adds a tag to hosts and keeps their other tags.

## SYNTAX

### ByName (Default)

```
Add-ZbxTag [-Name] <string> [[-Value] <string>] [-Force] -InputObject <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByTag

```
Add-ZbxTag [-Force] -InputObject <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> -Tag <ZabbixTagRequest[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The API replaces a host's whole tag set on update, so this reads each host's current tags first and sends them back with the new tags added; existing tags are never lost, and a tag with the same name and value already on the host is kept once. Works on hosts only. Every tag given or piped in is applied to every host, in one host.update call. Writes nothing unless -PassThru is given. Supports -WhatIf/-Confirm (ConfirmImpact Medium).

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Add a tag to a host

```powershell
Add-ZbxTag -InputObject 'web-01' -Name 'team' -Value 'shop' -PassThru | ForEach-Object Tags | Select-Object Tag, Value
```

The tag is merged with the host's current tags (host.update with the full list), so env=prod stays. -PassThru writes the updated host.

### Example 2: Tag every host a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | Add-ZbxTag -Name 'backup' -Value 'daily'
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' -SelectTags |
    Select-Object HostName, @{ n = 'Tags'; e = { ($_.Tags | ForEach-Object { '{0}={1}' -f $_.Tag, $_.Value }) -join ', ' } }
```

Get-ZbxHost writes host objects; Add-ZbxTag binds each one.

### Example 3: Add a tag without a value, positionally

```powershell
Add-ZbxTag 'maintenance' -InputObject 'db-01'
(Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-01' -SelectTags).Tags | Select-Object Tag, Value
```

-Name and -Value are positions 0 and 1 (-Value may be left out); the hosts come from the pipeline or -InputObject.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Value (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixTagRequest[]`: Bound to -Tag (ByValue). A tag to set on an object: a name with an optional value, such as env=prod.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixHost`: Represents a Zabbix host object.
